original_value: The increase in the elderly population in today’s society entails the need for new policies to maintain an adequate level of care without excessively increasing social spending. One of the possible options is to promote home care for the elderly. In this sense, this paper introduces a personal assistant designed to help elderly people in their activities of daily living. This system, called EMERALD, is comprised of a sensing platform and different mechanisms for emotion detection and decision-making that combined produces a cognitive assistant that engages users in Active Aging. The contribution of the paper is twofold—on the one hand, the integration of low-cost sensors that among other characteristics allows for detecting the emotional state of the user at an affordable cost; on the other hand, an automatic activity suggestion module that engages the users, mainly oriented to the elderly, in a healthy lifestyle. Moreover, by continuously correcting the system using the on-line monitoring carried out through the sensors integrated in the system, the system is personalized, and, in broad terms, emotionally intelligent. A functional prototype is being currently tested in a daycare centre in the northern area of Portugal where preliminary tests show positive results.

result.paraphrase: With the growing elderly population, society needs new policies to ensure adequate care without sharply raising social spending, and one option is to encourage home care for older adults. This paper presents EMERALD, a personal assistant designed to support elderly people in daily activities. The system combines a sensing platform with emotion-detection and decision-making mechanisms to create a cognitive assistant that promotes Active Aging. The paper’s contribution is twofold: it integrates low-cost sensors that, among other features, enable affordable detection of the user’s emotional state; and it includes an automatic activity suggestion module aimed mainly at older users to foster a healthy lifestyle. By continuously refining the system through online monitoring from its built-in sensors, EMERALD is personalized and, broadly speaking, emotionally intelligent. A functional prototype is currently being tested in a daycare centre in northern Portugal, where preliminary trials have shown positive results.
